title: sutura-align samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the sutura-align input samplesheet

pair_id.errorMessage: pair_id must be provided and contain only letters, numbers, and _.-

reference.errorMessage: reference section path (.h5ad file or Space Ranger dir) is required

moving.errorMessage: moving section path (.h5ad file or Space Ranger dir) is required

method.errorMessage: method must be one of: auto, sutura, paste2

gate_refine.errorMessage: gate_refine must be a boolean-like value
